units.rawText: Helios Sector, the Chocolaterie under construction.
units.displayText: Helios Sector, the Chocolaterie under construction.

spans.text: Helios Sector, the Chocolaterie under construction.

units.rawText: Zzp... confirmed. Basic framework complete.
units.displayText: Zzp... confirmed. Basic framework complete.

spans.text: Zzp... confirmed. Basic framework complete.

units.rawText: Now, the Chocolaterie can at least perform its most basic function—the creation of chocolate. A fine result, certainly.
units.displayText: Now, the Chocolaterie can at least perform its most basic function—the creation of chocolate. A fine result, certainly.

spans.text: Now, the Chocolaterie can at least perform its most basic function—the creation of chocolate. A fine result, certainly.

units.rawText: The equipment out front doesn't seem to quite match up with what's documented. Let me have another look.
units.displayText: The equipment out front doesn't seem to quite match up with what's documented. Let me have another look.

spans.text: The equipment out front doesn't seem to quite match up with what's documented. Let me have another look.

units.rawText: Observing the diligent Penumbra, Uranus emits an electronic noise, seemingly an expression of amusement.
units.displayText: Observing the diligent Penumbra, Uranus emits an electronic noise, seemingly an expression of amusement.

spans.text: Observing the diligent Penumbra, Uranus emits an electronic noise, seemingly an expression of amusement.

units.rawText: Since the commencement of our work on the Chocolaterie, you have yet to take a break, Mr. Penumbra.
units.displayText: Since the commencement of our work on the Chocolaterie, you have yet to take a break, Mr. Penumbra.

spans.text: Since the commencement of our work on the Chocolaterie, you have yet to take a break, Mr. Penumbra.

units.rawText: As unwilling as you appear, you're giving it your all :)
units.displayText: As unwilling as you appear, you're giving it your all :)

spans.text: As unwilling as you appear, you're giving it your all :)

units.rawText: Sigh... it was assigned to me by the Professor after all.
units.displayText: Sigh... it was assigned to me by the Professor after all.

spans.text: Sigh... it was assigned to me by the Professor after all.

units.rawText: And if the Chocolaterie can be restored to its former state, I'm sure Choco and those robots will be quite happy.
units.displayText: And if the Chocolaterie can be restored to its former state, I'm sure Choco and those robots will be quite happy.

spans.text: And if the Chocolaterie can be restored to its former state, I'm sure Choco and those robots will be quite happy.

units.rawText: Hey~ Penumbra, Uranus~
units.displayText: Hey~ Penumbra, Uranus~

spans.text: Hey~ Penumbra, Uranus~

units.rawText: Choco emerges from the kitchen, and beckons to them.
units.displayText: Choco emerges from the kitchen, and beckons to them.

spans.text: Choco emerges from the kitchen, and beckons to them.

units.rawText: I've made sweets, come have a taste!
units.displayText: I've made sweets, come have a taste!

spans.text: I've made sweets, come have a taste!

units.rawText: The rich aroma of chocolate seeks out the nostrils at great distance, bringing happiness.
units.displayText: The rich aroma of chocolate seeks out the nostrils at great distance, bringing happiness.

spans.text: The rich aroma of chocolate seeks out the nostrils at great distance, bringing happiness.

units.rawText: The Chocolaterie's not quite up and running and the tools aren't ideal, but luckily, the materials are of the finest quality. I've no doubt these are super delicious!
units.displayText: The Chocolaterie's not quite up and running and the tools aren't ideal, but luckily, the materials are of the finest quality. I've no doubt these are super delicious!

spans.text: The Chocolaterie's not quite up and running and the tools aren't ideal, but luckily, the materials are of the finest quality. I've no doubt these are super delicious!

units.rawText: Here, these are for you~
units.displayText: Here, these are for you~

spans.text: Here, these are for you~

units.rawText: <size=40>[｡◕ᴗ◕｡ Waow~ chocolate!]</size>
units.displayText: [｡◕ᴗ◕｡ Waow~ chocolate!]

spans.text: [｡◕ᴗ◕｡ Waow~ chocolate!]

units.rawText: The three robots hold the chocolates in their robotic hands, forming a circle in which to enjoy these boons after a day of work.
units.displayText: The three robots hold the chocolates in their robotic hands, forming a circle in which to enjoy these boons after a day of work.

spans.text: The three robots hold the chocolates in their robotic hands, forming a circle in which to enjoy these boons after a day of work.

units.rawText: This portion's for Zion, this one's for Uranus, and this one's for Penumbra! Just right!
units.displayText: This portion's for Zion, this one's for Uranus, and this one's for Penumbra! Just right!

spans.text: This portion's for Zion, this one's for Uranus, and this one's for Penumbra! Just right!

units.rawText: Molded into the shapes of the little robots, the chocolates are adorable in shape and almost lifelike.
units.displayText: Molded into the shapes of the little robots, the chocolates are adorable in shape and almost lifelike.

spans.text: Molded into the shapes of the little robots, the chocolates are adorable in shape and almost lifelike.

units.rawText: Sweets that eat away at the mind... they make people let down their guard, and become depraved in opulence.
units.displayText: Sweets that eat away at the mind... they make people let down their guard, and become depraved in opulence.

spans.text: Sweets that eat away at the mind... they make people let down their guard, and become depraved in opulence.

units.rawText: Eh? Do Choco's chocolates... really have such terrifying effects?
units.displayText: Eh? Do Choco's chocolates... really have such terrifying effects?

spans.text: Eh? Do Choco's chocolates... really have such terrifying effects?

units.rawText: Penumbra frantically waves his hands as a distressed expression makes itself onto Choco's face.
units.displayText: Penumbra frantically waves his hands as a distressed expression makes itself onto Choco's face.

spans.text: Penumbra frantically waves his hands as a distressed expression makes itself onto Choco's face.

units.rawText: Ahh... I'm not saying your chocolates aren't good, I just don't have sweets often.
units.displayText: Ahh... I'm not saying your chocolates aren't good, I just don't have sweets often.

spans.text: Ahh... I'm not saying your chocolates aren't good, I just don't have sweets often.

units.rawText: Beeeeeep—these are no common sweets. They are the legendary ROBOPUP chocolates, unmatched in deliciousness!
units.displayText: Beeeeeep—these are no common sweets. They are the legendary ROBOPUP chocolates, unmatched in deliciousness!

spans.text: Beeeeeep—these are no common sweets. They are the legendary ROBOPUP chocolates, unmatched in deliciousness!

units.rawText: Uranus picks up a piece, putting it to his olfactory transducers. The sensors kick into overdrive, and his spirits soon leap to a higher level.
units.displayText: Uranus picks up a piece, putting it to his olfactory transducers. The sensors kick into overdrive, and his spirits soon leap to a higher level.

spans.text: Uranus picks up a piece, putting it to his olfactory transducers. The sensors kick into overdrive, and his spirits soon leap to a higher level.

units.rawText: A top 10 eat of the cloud indeed!
units.displayText: A top 10 eat of the cloud indeed!

spans.text: A top 10 eat of the cloud indeed!

units.rawText: Ms. Choco's mastery of the art has created a perfect balance between the chocolate's rich fragrance and the nuts' natural aroma. Ahh~ the distilled essence of all that is earthly in the season of autumn...
units.displayText: Ms. Choco's mastery of the art has created a perfect balance between the chocolate's rich fragrance and the nuts' natural aroma. Ahh~ the distilled essence of all that is earthly in the season of autumn...

spans.text: Ms. Choco's mastery of the art has created a perfect balance between the chocolate's rich fragrance and the nuts' natural aroma. Ahh~ the distilled essence of all that is earthly in the season of autumn...

units.rawText: Beeeeeep—I have no gustatory sensors with which to savor this delicacy, but I can tell that it is a fine confection from the scent alone.
units.displayText: Beeeeeep—I have no gustatory sensors with which to savor this delicacy, but I can tell that it is a fine confection from the scent alone.

spans.text: Beeeeeep—I have no gustatory sensors with which to savor this delicacy, but I can tell that it is a fine confection from the scent alone.

units.rawText: Thank you for your most generous work, Ms. Choco.
units.displayText: Thank you for your most generous work, Ms. Choco.

spans.text: Thank you for your most generous work, Ms. Choco.

units.rawText: Thank you, Uranus. Gee, you're making me embarrassed.
units.displayText: Thank you, Uranus. Gee, you're making me embarrassed.

spans.text: Thank you, Uranus. Gee, you're making me embarrassed.

units.rawText: Hmm... if one requires the replenishment of energy, it could serve quite well.
units.displayText: Hmm... if one requires the replenishment of energy, it could serve quite well.

spans.text: Hmm... if one requires the replenishment of energy, it could serve quite well.

units.rawText: Uranus raises a piece of chocolate up high, giving it all his attention as if it were a work of art. His old-fashioned frame in its motley colors strikes a sheer contrast with his spirited robotic voice.
units.displayText: Uranus raises a piece of chocolate up high, giving it all his attention as if it were a work of art. His old-fashioned frame in its motley colors strikes a sheer contrast with his spirited robotic voice.

spans.text: Uranus raises a piece of chocolate up high, giving it all his attention as if it were a work of art. His old-fashioned frame in its motley colors strikes a sheer contrast with his spirited robotic voice.

units.rawText: Zzp—Mr. Penumbra is correct, but I, Uranus, am of the mind that they are a fine choice, no matter the situation.
units.displayText: Zzp—Mr. Penumbra is correct, but I, Uranus, am of the mind that they are a fine choice, no matter the situation.

spans.text: Zzp—Mr. Penumbra is correct, but I, Uranus, am of the mind that they are a fine choice, no matter the situation.

units.rawText: An Exile can be a warrior on the battlefield, but when a warrior hangs up their weapon, they are no different from a normal Doll.
units.displayText: An Exile can be a warrior on the battlefield, but when a warrior hangs up their weapon, they are no different from a normal Doll.

spans.text: An Exile can be a warrior on the battlefield, but when a warrior hangs up their weapon, they are no different from a normal Doll.

units.rawText: A warrior can enjoy life in the selfsame way, and find their own reason to exist.
units.displayText: A warrior can enjoy life in the selfsame way, and find their own reason to exist.

spans.text: A warrior can enjoy life in the selfsame way, and find their own reason to exist.

units.rawText: Don't focus on me constantly. Go look at the sunset, listen to some music you like. Doesn't that sound better?
units.displayText: Don't focus on me constantly. Go look at the sunset, listen to some music you like. Doesn't that sound better?

spans.text: Don't focus on me constantly. Go look at the sunset, listen to some music you like. Doesn't that sound better?

units.rawText: Let your stifled emotions out with the music, feel the free spirit of nature.
units.displayText: Let your stifled emotions out with the music, feel the free spirit of nature.

spans.text: Let your stifled emotions out with the music, feel the free spirit of nature.

units.rawText: Instead of guarding me, I would rather have you find your own happiness and reason to exist.
units.displayText: Instead of guarding me, I would rather have you find your own happiness and reason to exist.

spans.text: Instead of guarding me, I would rather have you find your own happiness and reason to exist.

units.rawText: The Professor would rather have me... find my own reason to exist.
units.displayText: The Professor would rather have me... find my own reason to exist.

spans.text: The Professor would rather have me... find my own reason to exist.

units.rawText: Penumbra stares somewhat blankly at the chocolate in Choco's hands. Emulating Uranus, he puts it to his nose, gently sniffing.
units.displayText: Penumbra stares somewhat blankly at the chocolate in Choco's hands. Emulating Uranus, he puts it to his nose, gently sniffing.

spans.text: Penumbra stares somewhat blankly at the chocolate in Choco's hands. Emulating Uranus, he puts it to his nose, gently sniffing.

units.rawText: It... didn't seem so overwhelmingly sweet, only giving off a faint sugary scent. Now, to place it in the mouth...
units.displayText: It... didn't seem so overwhelmingly sweet, only giving off a faint sugary scent. Now, to place it in the mouth...

spans.text: It... didn't seem so overwhelmingly sweet, only giving off a faint sugary scent. Now, to place it in the mouth...

units.rawText: The hard outer shell gives way to a velvety smooth syrup... tch... he's still not used to the taste.
units.displayText: The hard outer shell gives way to a velvety smooth syrup... tch... he's still not used to the taste.

spans.text: The hard outer shell gives way to a velvety smooth syrup... tch... he's still not used to the taste.

units.rawText: ...It... is a fine confectionary indeed.
units.displayText: ...It... is a fine confectionary indeed.

spans.text: ...It... is a fine confectionary indeed.

units.rawText: Watching as Penumbra's furrowed brow slowly relaxes, Choco nods with elation.
units.displayText: Watching as Penumbra's furrowed brow slowly relaxes, Choco nods with elation.

spans.text: Watching as Penumbra's furrowed brow slowly relaxes, Choco nods with elation.

units.rawText: Yeah!
units.displayText: Yeah!

spans.text: Yeah!
